description:
❤️ *Kojagiri Pournima – Full Moon, Full Hearts & Full Attendance!* 🌕🥛😂

Dear Members,

What a lovely evening filled with laughter, togetherness, masala milk, appe and lots of dry fruits! ❤️

A special thanks to *Tejaswini* for the delicious masala milk, *Sarla* for the yummy appe, and *Amit & Deepak* for personally distributing milk to everyone. 🥛 A little extra love from my side Amit gave me extra Dry-fruits 😜❤️

*But honestly, the best part of the evening was not the food… it was having all of you together!* 🥰

As your President, I have just one small wish — *I want to see this kind of majority in every meeting!* 😂❤️

If Kojagiri can bring everyone together with masala milk and appe, imagine what we can achieve together through Rotary! 😉🌟

Let’s make every meeting a celebration, every gathering a memory, and every project a reason to be proud of our club.

Members ki attendance bhi full moon jaisi bright rehni chahiye! 🌕😂
